content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The undo effect is where the model's transition meets the variables it moves and the selection it reads; the effect the claim names — the reverts recorded against the operation it undoes, the position one further back, the marker list standing — is read out of specs/markers/undo.qnt's `undo` action. The prerequisites are spec documents in their own constrained notation and prose, so the gate spans two cells, one of them the matrix's structured→natural default — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix.
